open_graph.og:title: Using the Web Speech API - Web APIs | MDN
open_graph.og:description: The Web Speech API provides two distinct areas of functionality — speech recognition and speech synthesis (also known as text to speech, or TTS) — which open up interesting possibilities for accessibility and control. This article provides an introduction to both the areas, along with demos.
